added.statement: When two native hook processes overlap for the same client/session/workspace state scope, the shared swarm hook shall allow only one process to poll, render, and record a durable delivery.
acceptance_criteria: A controlled concurrent invocation with one durable message emits exactly one native context.
The contending invocation does not call poll, ack, emitOutput, or write the state file.
A later non-overlapping boundary acknowledges the one preserved pending delivery.
A live kernel lease blocks a second hook without any poll, acknowledgement, output, or state mutation.
When the lease-owning process exits, the next hook acquires the same stable lock file and can deliver; a pre-existing unlocked lock file does not block delivery.
A helper that does not report lock readiness within the bounded acquisition interval returns without polling or mutating state.
A legacy non-regular lock path fails closed and is neither moved nor deleted.

ears.trigger: two hook processes overlap for one state scope
ears.response: serialize the state transition so the durable delivery is emitted only once

breaker.condition: a concurrent pair of hook invocations emits duplicate context or a lock prevents later recovery

added.statement: When the detect-secrets work-packet fixture invokes the upstream detect-secrets hook, the fixture shall provide the declared pinned Git executable only to that child process so the test remains compatible with the agent-facing Git refusal shim.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/test-detect-secrets-work-packet-filter.mjs passes under the normal Nix development environment.
The parent process PATH is not modified and the production lefthook command remains unchanged.
repo check no longer fails because the upstream fixture inherited the refusal shim.

ears.trigger: the upstream detect-secrets hook performs its internal Git baseline check
ears.response: supply the declared pinned Git path only to that child process

breaker.condition: the fixture fails with the agent Git refusal or must alter the parent PATH to pass

added.statement: When the detect-secrets scanner sees a 40-character Git revision in this work packet, it shall exempt exactly one canonical top-level source revision only in current-spec.snapshot.json or a red/green proof record, while retaining detection for nested, duplicate, duplicate-key, malformed, or differently named values.
acceptance_criteria: The focused fixture runs both detect-secrets scan and detect-secrets-hook for current-spec.snapshot.json, red-proof.json, and red-fixture-proof.json with canonical source revisions.
A nested source-shaped record, a duplicated revision, a duplicate JSON object key, a malformed source record, and a differently named evidence file remain detectable.
The production lefthook command remains unchanged.

ears.trigger: an entropy detector reports a candidate 40-character Git revision
ears.response: exempt only one canonical top-level source revision at an approved work-packet path

breaker.condition: a canonical allowed source revision is reported, or a noncanonical occurrence is filtered

test_plan.description: Controlled in-process and separate-process hook calls must produce one durable poll/output path, preserve deferred acknowledgement, honor a held kernel lease, deliver after a normal or killed holder exits without replacing the stable lock file, fail silently when the lock helper cannot become ready, and preserve a legacy non-regular lock path.
The detect-secrets work-packet fixture must run its upstream hook with the child-only pinned Git path while retaining the parent guard.

The detect-secrets filter must exercise scan and upstream-hook paths for every exact admitted source-revision filename, while adversarial nested, duplicate, duplicate-key, malformed, and differently named values remain reported.
